snippet.title: Shuffle Tactics - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Shuffle Tactics is AVAILABLE NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186580/Shuffle_Tactics/

In Shuffle Tactics, our dark fantasy, tactical deckbuilding RPG, embark on an action-packed adventure with terrain-focused environmental tactics, side-kicks, and in-depth deckbuilding!

⚔️ Face off against fearsome Dwellers with three playable heroes
🤝 Team up with 10 quirky sidekicks, each wielding distinct abilities
🎨 Enjoy iconic pixel art direction
🃏 Build and refine your deck to master your own tactical playstyle 
🗺️ Explore the 6 regions of the Kingdom of Asteria, from the outskirts of a capital city in The Deluge, to The Snarl's lush forest.
👑 Survive the battles and rise as a true Herald of Legend 
🔁 Enjoy huge replayability by unlocking new cards, charms, and secrets  

Time to strategize your path to victory and claim your rightful place as the Herald of Legend!
